meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后,Claude的容器代理会改从`.env`文件读取Anthropic的密钥或令牌,并注入到请求中,不再经过OneCLI网关。只有开启开关时生效,原网关路径保持不变。
howto.when: 当`.env`中设置`NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true`,且存在API密钥或OAuth令牌时,每次容器启动构建参数都会注入凭证;未开启标志则无动作。

say.text: 帮我启用原生凭证代理,从.env读取Anthropic API密钥。
say.note: 会设置开关并读取.env配置。

say.text: 我想改用Claude订阅令牌,不用OneCLI网关。

howto.what_en: Once installed, the container agent reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) from .env and injects them into container API requests instead of going through the OneCLI gateway. It only acts when the flag is enabled; the original gateway path stays unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env and an API key or OAuth token is present, at each container spawn while building args. If the flag is unset, it is a no-op.

say_en.text: Enable the native credential proxy and read the Anthropic API key from .env.
I want to use my Claude subscription token instead of the OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: Prompts you to run claude setup-token and writes it to .env.

say_en.text: Set NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS to true and add a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.
